modos.descricao: Escolhe 2 tribos. Personagens dessas tribos devem se atacar primeiro.

params.descricao: Tribal War: tribos escolhidas devem se atacar primeiro

_metadata.texto_original: Choose 2 tribes. Characters from these tribes must attack each other before they attack any other opponents in the game. If members of both tribes are in 1 pack, then 1 must be discarded (no victory points will be gained).
